title: Manal K. Elzalabany
text:
Hi! I am Manal K. Elzalabany, a multilingual epidemiologist, working currently as a Senior Data Analyst at Imperial College London, UK.
I have a broad expertise working in population health data analytics and data management in academic institutions in Lebanon, Germany, United Kingdom, and United Nations Organizations.  I also worked as a Lancet-associated researcher of Syrian War & humanitarian crisis.
I have worked on the management & analysis of different population datasets, such as COVID-19 datasets & Household surveys from 23 countries, COVID-19 Global demographic dataset COVerAGE-DB hosted in MPIDR, Germany & currently working on REDDIE an EU-Horizon project using longitudinal datasets derived from the English National Registeries, such as National Diabates Audit (NDA), Hospital Episode Statistics (HES) and Office of National Statistics. 

I hold MSc Applied Statistics in Health Sciences from Strathclyde university, 2024, MPH in Epidemiology & Biostatistics from the American University of Beirut, 2018, and BVSc in Veterinary Medical Sciences from Cairo University, 2009 . I am an expert user of R/ RStudio, Rmarkdown & Quarto, and Shiny Web applications, among other analysis tools.
